changelog: **Org attributes in the match score (#3424):** a rule set can weigh an org attribute (`UserAttributeValue`, directory data from SSO sync or the roster feed) with the new `attribute:<key>` dimension family and `config.attributeMode` = `same` ("prefer the same site"), `different` ("a mentor from another business unit") or `gte_mentor` (NUMBER attributes: "mentor level ≥ mentee level"). A value missing on either side — or an attribute deleted since — scores neutral, never a penalty or an error. Values load in bulk, one query per side (`src/lib/matching/attributeValues.ts`), so suggest, simulation and match rounds read the dimension with no N+1. The save route refuses an attribute the org does not have (`400 unknown_attribute`); the rule editor offers only the org's own attributes and the breakdown names them by their label.

en: Matching rules can now weigh your organisation's own attributes — for example the same site, a different business unit, or a mentor at a higher level.
tr: Eşleştirme kuralları artık kurumunuzun kendi niteliklerini tartabilir — örneğin aynı lokasyon, farklı iş birimi ya da daha üst seviyede bir mentor.
de: Matching-Regeln können jetzt die eigenen Merkmale Ihrer Organisation gewichten – etwa denselben Standort, einen anderen Geschäftsbereich oder einen Mentor auf höherer Ebene.
